#!/usr/bin/env bash
# /tmp/delent/b/lib.sh - shared helpers for Lane B
set -u
LANE=/tmp/delent/b
EVID=$LANE/evidence
TL=$LANE/timeline.jsonl
QL=$LANE/queries.jsonl
BASE="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e"
KEY="YmQ4NTRjZWEtMjZkZC00ZTkwLWE2NjgtOTZkMDdjZTk0NzIy"
SEQ=0

mkdir -p "$EVID"

nowutc() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }

logtl() { # logtl step action entityType id http
  local step="$1" action="$2" et="$3" id="$4" http="$5"
  local ts; ts=$(nowutc)
  printf '{"step":"%s","action":"%s","entityType":"%s","id":"%s","tsUTC":"%s","http":"%s"}\n' "$step" "$action" "$et" "$id" "$ts" "$http" >> "$TL"
}

# req method url outfile [data] -> echoes http code
req() {
  local method="$1" url="$2" out="$3" data="${4:-}"
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1))
  local code
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -H "x-request-id: delent-B-$(printf '%03d' "$SEQ")" \
      "$url" -d "$data")
  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: delent-B-$(printf '%03d' "$SEQ")" \
      "$url")
  fi
  echo "$code"
}

# getq step desc outfile extra_args...  -> queries /deleted, records status sidecar
getq() {
  local step="$1" desc="$2" out="$3"; shift 3
  local url="$BASE/entities/deleted"
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -G \
    -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: delent-B-$(printf '%03d' "$SEQ")" \
    "$url" "$@")
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1))
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out.status"
  local count ids codes
  if jq -e '.response' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq '.response | length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.response[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.response[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
  elif jq -e 'type=="array"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq 'length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
  else
    count="NA"; ids="NA"; codes="NA"
  fi
  printf '{"step":"%s","desc":"%s","http":"%s","count":"%s","ids":"%s","documentCodes":"%s","file":"%s"}\n' \
    "$step" "$desc" "$code" "$count" "$ids" "$codes" "$out" >> "$QL"
  logtl "$step" "deleted-query" "-" "-" "$code"
  echo "$code|$count|$ids|$codes"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Lane B shared helpers - DELETED ENTITIES behavioral lifecycle
LANE=/tmp/delent/b
EVID=$LANE/evidence
TL=$LANE/timeline.jsonl
QL=$LANE/queries.jsonl
BASE="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e"
KEY="YmQ4NTRjZWEtMjZkZC00ZTkwLWE2NjgtOTZkMDdjZTk0NzIy"
SEQ=0

mkdir -p "$EVID"

nowutc() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }

logtl() { # logtl <step> <action> <entityType> <id> <http>
  local step="$1" action="$2" et="$3" id="$4" http="$5"
  local ts; ts=$(nowutc)
  printf '{"step":"%s","action":"%s","entityType":"%s","id":"%s","tsUTC":"%s","http":"%s"}\n' \
    "$step" "$action" "$et" "$id" "$ts" "$http" >> "$TL"
}

# adds <seconds> <baseUTC> -> baseUTC+seconds (UTC, second precision)
adds() {
  local secs="$1" base="$2"
  local clean ep
  clean=$(printf '%s' "$base" | sed -E 's/\.([0-9]+)Z$/Z/; s/Z$//')
  if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then
    ep=$(date -u -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" "$clean" "+%s" 2>/dev/null)
  else
    ep=$(date -u -d "$clean" "+%s" 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  if [ -z "$ep" ]; then echo "PARSE_ERR:$base"; return 1; fi
  ep=$((ep + secs))
  if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then
    date -u -r "$ep" "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
  else
    date -u -d "@$ep" "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
  fi
}

# req <method> <url> <outfile> [data] -> echoes http code; sleeps 0.4s
req() {
  local method="$1" url="$2" out="$3" data="${4:-}"
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1)); local rid; rid=$(printf 'delent-B-%03d' "$SEQ")
  local code
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-request-id: $rid" \
      "$url" -d "$data")
  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: $rid" "$url")
  fi
  sleep 0.4
  echo "$code"
}

# getq <step> <desc> <outfile> <expectName> [curl -G args...] -> logs query row
getq() {
  local step="$1" desc="$2" out="$3" ename="$4"; shift 4
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1)); local rid; rid=$(printf 'delent-B-%03d' "$SEQ")
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -G \
    -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: $rid" \
    "$BASE/entities/deleted" "$@")
  sleep 0.4
  local count ids codes present
  if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
    count="ERR"; ids="NA"; codes="NA"; present="na"
  elif jq -e 'type=="object" and has("response")' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq '.response | length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.response[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.response[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
    if [ -n "$ename" ]; then
      present=$(jq -r --arg n "$ename" '[.response[]? | (.document|tostring) | contains($n)] | any' "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo na)
    else present="na"; fi
  elif jq -e 'type=="array"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq 'length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
    if [ -n "$ename" ]; then
      present=$(jq -r --arg n "$ename" '[.[]? | (.document|tostring) | contains($n)] | any' "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo na)
    else present="na"; fi
  else
    count="NA"; ids="NA"; codes="NA"; present="na"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out.status"
  printf '{"step":"%s","desc":"%s","http":"%s","count":"%s","ids":"%s","documentCodes":"%s","present":"%s","expectName":"%s","file":"%s"}\n' \
    "$step" "$desc" "$code" "$count" "$ids" "$codes" "$present" "$ename" "$out" >> "$QL"
  logtl "$step" "deleted-query" "-" "-" "$code"
  echo "QUERY[$step] $desc -> http=$code count=$count present=$present codes=$codes"
}

  else
    ep=$(date -u -d "$clean" "+%s" 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  if [ -z "$ep" ]; then echo "PARSE_ERR:$base"; return 1; fi
  ep=$((ep + secs))
  if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then
    date -u -r "$ep" "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
  else
    date -u -d "@$ep" "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
  fi
}

# req <method> <url> <outfile> [data] -> echoes http code; sleeps 0.4s
req() {
  local method="$1" url="$2" out="$3" data="${4:-}"
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1)); local rid; rid=$(printf 'delent-B-%03d' "$SEQ")
  local code
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-request-id: $rid" \
      "$url" -d "$data")
  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: $rid" "$url")
  fi
  sleep 0.4
  echo "$code"
}

# getq <step> <desc> <outfile> <expectName> [curl -G args...] -> logs query row
getq() {
  local step="$1" desc="$2" out="$3" ename="$4"; shift 4
  SEQ=$((SEQ+1)); local rid; rid=$(printf 'delent-B-%03d' "$SEQ")
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -o "$out" -w "%{http_code}" -G \
    -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "x-request-id: $rid" \
    "$BASE/entities/deleted" "$@")
  sleep 0.4
  local count ids codes present
  if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
    count="ERR"; ids="NA"; codes="NA"; present="na"
  elif jq -e 'type=="object" and has("response")' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq '.response | length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.response[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.response[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
    if [ -n "$ename" ]; then
      present=$(jq -r --arg n "$ename" '[.response[]? | (.document|tostring) | contains($n)] | any' "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo na)
    else present="na"; fi
  elif jq -e 'type=="array"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    count=$(jq 'length' "$out")
    ids=$(jq -r '[.[].id] | join(",")' "$out")
    codes=$(jq -r '[.[].documentCode] | join(",")' "$out")
    if [ -n "$ename" ]; then
      present=$(jq -r --arg n "$ename" '[.[]? | (.document|tostring) | contains($n)] | any' "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo na)
    else present="na"; fi
  else
    count="NA"; ids="NA"; codes="NA"; present="na"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out.status"
  printf '{"step":"%s","desc":"%s","http":"%s","count":"%s","ids":"%s","documentCodes":"%s","present":"%s","expectName":"%s","file":"%s"}\n' \
    "$step" "$desc" "$code" "$count" "$ids" "$codes" "$present" "$ename" "$out" >> "$QL"
  logtl "$step" "deleted-query" "-" "-" "$code"
  echo "QUERY[$step] $desc -> http=$code count=$count present=$present codes=$codes"
}
"
}
